ink_note: Night is the approved near-black for noses and eyes; no extra black or warm accent.
research_basis: Design brief supplied by the owner; no new external research or independent factual verification claimed.
rendering: Pillow only. 2560px RGBA masters -> LANCZOS at every target size. Proofs composited at 1:1, with no hand-tuned small variants. Silhouettes preserve master alpha and use one constant snow RGB.
small_variant_decision: No stripped-down production icon is supplied: these tiles deliberately expose what unchanged artwork loses. A separate small variant would be a follow-up after concept selection.
selection_criteria: Guarding communicated by physical relationship to stored data
Mature character tone beside software typography

directions.name: coil
directions.concept: A sleeping fox encircles layered records; protection continues at rest.
directions.starting_point_and_reason: Curled around a stack: retained because the tail can become the boundary of the store.
directions.product_mapping: Resilience: passive enclosure rather than a security prop.
directions.species_cues: Long profile muzzle (Vigil uses a frontal tapered muzzle), triangular ears, pale coat with blue-grey shadow, body-scale bushy tail.

visual_review.at_16px: A pale oval with a small head and dark layered centre. Curl survives; fox identity is weak.
visual_review.silhouette_assessment: FAIL: a curled animal / oval. The snout touches the enclosing tail and disappears in one ink.

directions.role: Character layer; not a proposed automatic replacement for the shipped mark.

directions.name: den
directions.concept: An alert fox occupies the entrance of a cutaway snow burrow; records lie inside its arch.
directions.starting_point_and_reason: Burrow entrance: retained to make storage feel like a habitat, not an adjacent object.
directions.product_mapping: Search: ears attend to activity at the store entrance.
directions.species_cues: Long profile muzzle (Vigil uses a frontal tapered muzzle), triangular ears, pale coat with blue-grey shadow, body-scale bushy tail.

visual_review.at_16px: An arch with a small pale animal at its threshold; the burrow dominates. Not a fox icon.
visual_review.silhouette_assessment: FAIL: arch and animal merge into a grotto-like mass; exposed muzzle is too small.

directions.role: Character layer; not a proposed automatic replacement for the shipped mark.

directions.name: summit
directions.concept: A seated fox perches directly on three broad storage strata, tail descending alongside them.
directions.starting_point_and_reason: Layered perch: retained for its direct association with an LSM-style store.
directions.product_mapping: Adaptability: a stable lookout above changing storage strata.
directions.species_cues: Long profile muzzle (Vigil uses a frontal tapered muzzle), triangular ears, pale coat with blue-grey shadow, body-scale bushy tail.

visual_review.at_16px: An upright long-eared animal on stripes. Perch reads; species needs more pixels.
visual_review.silhouette_assessment: PASS at 256px: long tapered snout, triangular ears and large outward tail remain exposed. Stack still adds visual weight.

directions.role: Character layer; not a proposed automatic replacement for the shipped mark.

directions.name: mantle
directions.concept: An oversized tail arches over a compact record cluster while the fox watches from one end.
directions.starting_point_and_reason: Tail shelter: retained because the data is underneath the animal, never beside a badge.
directions.product_mapping: Resilience: the winter tail insulates what is stored.
directions.species_cues: Long profile muzzle (Vigil uses a frontal tapered muzzle), triangular ears, pale coat with blue-grey shadow, body-scale bushy tail.

visual_review.at_16px: A low canopy with a pointed head at one end. Tail shelter survives more than facial detail.
visual_review.silhouette_assessment: PASS at 256px: projecting snout, ears and the high bushy tail describe a side-profile fox.

directions.role: Character layer; not a proposed automatic replacement for the shipped mark.

directions.name: vigil
directions.concept: A frontal fox stands with chest forward and tail closing the perimeter around a small core.
directions.starting_point_and_reason: Head-on guardian: retained, using anatomy to form the boundary without drawing a shield.
directions.product_mapping: Watchfulness: forward ears and steady eyes express attention.
directions.species_cues: Long profile muzzle (Vigil uses a frontal tapered muzzle), triangular ears, pale coat with blue-grey shadow, body-scale bushy tail.

visual_review.at_16px: An alert pointed face over a pale body; the tiny protected core merges. Strongest small character.
visual_review.silhouette_assessment: FAIL strict species test: a frontal pointed-eared animal; hidden snout and merged tail permit a cat reading.

directions.role: Character layer; not a proposed automatic replacement for the shipped mark.

directions.name: cache
directions.concept: A fox emerges from a gap between data strata; its tail stays visible beyond the layers.
directions.starting_point_and_reason: Half-hidden inhabitant: retained to explore the database as the fox habitat.
directions.product_mapping: Embedded: the guardian lives within the stored layers.
directions.species_cues: Long profile muzzle (Vigil uses a frontal tapered muzzle), triangular ears, pale coat with blue-grey shadow, body-scale bushy tail.

visual_review.at_16px: A pale head between stripes with a tail on the side; the embedded idea becomes clutter.
visual_review.silhouette_assessment: FAIL: slabs dominate and erase the animal anatomy. Not a reliable fox silhouette.

directions.role: Character layer; not a proposed automatic replacement for the shipped mark.

directions.name: patrol
directions.concept: A long-bodied fox spans a horizontal run of segments; one forepaw rests on the middle segment.
directions.starting_point_and_reason: Standing watch: retained for the clearest physical claim of care and responsibility.
directions.product_mapping: Search: a listening profile surveys the data beneath its feet.
directions.species_cues: Long profile muzzle (Vigil uses a frontal tapered muzzle), triangular ears, pale coat with blue-grey shadow, body-scale bushy tail.

visual_review.at_16px: A long animal standing on a short baseline; muzzle and rear tail remain directional. Records merge.
visual_review.silhouette_assessment: PASS at 256px: long snout, triangular ears, standing legs and a very bushy tail remain distinct.

directions.role: Character layer; not a proposed automatic replacement for the shipped mark.

directions.name: kin
directions.concept: An adult watches outward while a smaller fox sleeps inside the arc of its tail.
directions.starting_point_and_reason: Parent and child: retained to revisit the old pair as an explicit character narrative.
directions.product_mapping: Continuity: a protected smaller member represents the entrusted data, without literal records.
directions.species_cues: Long profile muzzle (Vigil uses a frontal tapered muzzle), triangular ears, pale coat with blue-grey shadow, body-scale bushy tail.

visual_review.at_16px: Two pale bumps enclosed by a large tail; the smaller fox becomes a fleck.
visual_review.silhouette_assessment: PASS for the adult at 256px: outward pointed muzzle and ears are clear. FAIL for the child, which merges into the tail.

directions.role: Character layer; not a proposed automatic replacement for the shipped mark.

tiles.name: guard-compare-row
tiles.optical_normalization: Equal visible alpha-weighted area, approximately 28000px per composition; centered in eight equal cells. Data is included in visual mass.

reasons.patrol: Best exposed fox anatomy and explicit paw-to-record relationship; simplify the records for future small use.
reasons.mantle: Most ownable guardian idea: winter tail as shelter. Fewer storage shapes would improve reduction.
reasons.summit: Strong fox silhouette and clear storage strata; slightly conventional lookout metaphor.
reasons.kin: Warm continuity narrative and an identifiable adult; child fails in silhouette and at 16px.
reasons.vigil: Strongest small frontal face but fails the strict fox silhouette test; revise before advancing.
reasons.coil: Protective curl is coherent at hero size, but snout and tail collapse into an oval.
reasons.den: A habitat story with too much architectural mass; the fox becomes subordinate.
reasons.cache: Embedded concept is direct, but anatomy is fragmented by data layers.

recommendation.favicon: None passes both unmistakable fox recognition and integrated guardian meaning at 16px. Keep the shipped mark for tiny icons pending a separate reduction study.
